hooks.command: ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$ROOT" ] || exit 0; mkdir -p "$ROOT/.claude/.autosave-state"; f="$ROOT/.claude/.autosave-state/last-run"; now=$(date +%s); last=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ $((now - last)) -ge 180 ]; then echo "$now" > "$f"; nohup bash "$ROOT/.claude/worktree-autosave.sh" >> "$ROOT/.claude/.autosave-state/run.log" 2>&1 & fi

ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$ROOT" ] || exit 0; mkdir -p "$ROOT/.claude/.autosave-state"; bash "$ROOT/.claude/worktree-autosave.sh" >> "$ROOT/.claude/.autosave-state/run.log" 2>&1 || true
